title: Cosmic Shattered Veil
description: A surreal landscape features a large cracked circular portal dominating the center. Inside the orb are swirling purple galaxies forming eye-like shapes, a golden skull with green eyes floating above, and a small human silhouette standing in a reflective body of water below. The background shows green mountains under a starry night sky with nebulae.
prompt: Surreal cosmic landscape at night, a massive cracked circular portal overlays a mountain lake scene. Inside the orb, two swirling purple spiral galaxies form hypnotic eyes, a golden dripping skull with glowing green eyes floats above wearing bat-like wings, a lone human silhouette stands in colorful reflective water at the bottom. Green forested mountains and starry nebulae fill the background, intricate line details, mystical atmosphere.
